## indie Sets Date for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 14, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/900030961/files/doc_news/indie-Sets-Date-for-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-and-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


ALISO VIEJO, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


indie Semiconductor, Inc. (Nasdaq: INDI), an automotive solutions innovator, plans to conduct a conference call with analysts to discuss its third quarter 2026 results and business outlook on November 5, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Eastern time.


After the close of the market on November 5 and prior to the conference call, indie Semiconductor, Inc. (“indie”) will issue a copy of the earnings press release via Business Wire. The press release may also be viewed on indie’s website at[https://investors.indie.inc/news](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.indie.inc%2Fnews&esheet=54621231&newsitemid=20261014111396&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.indie.inc%2Fnews&index=1&md5=5448a704739a11d8ea055d59b82a39fc) .


To listen to the conference call via the Internet, please go to the Financials tab on the Investors page of indie’s website. To listen to the conference call via telephone, please call (877) 451-6152 (domestic) or (201) 389-0879 (international).


A replay of the conference call will be available beginning at 9:00 p.m. Eastern time on November 5, 2026, until 11:59 p.m. Eastern time on November 19, 2026, under the Financials tab on the Investors page of indie’s website, or by calling (844) 512-2921 (domestic) or (412) 317-6671 (international), Access ID: 13762494.


**About indie**


Headquartered in Aliso Viejo, CA, indie is accelerating ADAS intelligence across automotive, quantum, and Physical AI applications through next-generation hardware, system solutions, and perception software technologies. By developing high-performance, energy-efficient semiconductor, photonic, and software solutions, we are enabling machines to perceive, understand, and interact with the physical world. Spanning radar, computer vision, LiDAR, and ultrasound, our platforms power advanced safety, automation, positioning, and automated capabilities for leading automotive OEMs, intelligent machines, and emerging AI-driven systems worldwide.


Please visit us at[www.indie.inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.indie.inc&esheet=54621231&newsitemid=20261014111396&lan=en-US&anchor=www.indie.inc&index=2&md5=2fc7ac84222f9cb0f2d3fa457ffd8b79) to learn more.
